name: Rogue
description: Criminals, con artists, and pirates who operate outside the law.

assignments.name: Thief
assignments.description: You steal from the rich and give to... well, yourself mostly.

assignments.name: Enforcer
assignments.description: You are a leg-breaker, thug, or bodyguard for a criminal organisation.

assignments.name: Pirate
assignments.description: You are a space pirate, raiding ships and settlements.

events.description: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Mishap table but remain in career.

effects.detail: Roll on Mishap table, stay in career

events.effectDescription: You can choose to pay Cr1000 x 2D to avoid a prison term (roll twice on the Injury table) or serve time. If you serve time, lose one Benefit roll.

effects.detail: Pay fine or serve time (lose Benefit)

events.description: You are involved in the planning of an attack on a rival criminal enterprise.
events.effectDescription: Gain one of Electronics 1, Mechanic 1, Deception 1, or Streetwise 1.

effects.detail: Gain Electronics 1, Mechanic 1, Deception 1 or Streetwise 1

events.effectDescription: Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

events.description: You are given advanced training in a specialist field.
events.effectDescription: Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.

events.description: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Life Events table.

events.description: You have the opportunity to backstab a fellow rogue for personal gain.
events.effectDescription: If you do, gain DM+4 to your next advancement roll. If not, gain them as an Ally.

events.description: You are involved in a feud with a rival criminal organisation.
events.effectDescription: Roll Stealth or Gun Combat 8+. Succeed: gain an extra Benefit roll. Fail: roll on the Injury table.

effects.detail: Stealth/Gun Combat 8+ for Benefit or Injury

events.description: You are part of a gang and you are involved in a turf war.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll and gain an extra Benefit roll.

events.description: A crime lord offers you a position in their organisation.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+4 to your next advancement roll and gain an Ally.

mishaps.effectDescription: Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.

effects.detail: Roll twice on Injury table, take lower result

mishaps.description: Arrested. You must spend the next term in prison.
Betrayed by a partner in crime. Gain an Enemy.
A job goes wrong, forcing you to flee off-planet. Gain one of Deception 1, Pilot (Small Craft) 1, Athletics (Dexterity) 1 or Gunner 1.
mishaps.effectDescription: Gain Deception 1, Pilot (Small Craft) 1, Athletics (Dexterity) 1 or Gunner 1.

effects.detail: Gain Deception 1, Pilot 1, Athletics 1 or Gunner 1

mishaps.description: A police detective or rival criminal forces you to flee. Gain a Rival.
Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
